locations.name: Patchwork
locations.pitch: Where you start: a town of scrap shacks and gardens bolted together around an old motor court on the interstate.

locations.name: Starlite Crossing
locations.pitch: A gutted crossroads town just east of Patchwork, with the Orbit Diner and a filling station; ghouls nest in the ruins.

locations.name: Port Sterling - Downtown
locations.pitch: The bombed river city: towers, barricaded avenues, City Hall, and a radio cult holding the Atlas Building.

locations.name: Sterling Waterfront
locations.pitch: Warehouses and rusting barges; river traders run a fortified market on a beached ferry.

locations.name: Maple Grove
locations.pitch: Endless cul-de-sacs of picked-over houses; scavenger families and feral dogs.

locations.name: Mercy General Hospital
locations.pitch: Eight storeys of ghouls; the pharmacy vault on the top floor is still sealed.

locations.name: Victory Stadium
locations.pitch: A loud town in the bleachers of the collapsed stadium; shacks fill the stands, the field is a market by day and fight nights pack the bowl. Win in the ring and you're a legend.

locations.name: Atomic Plaza
locations.pitch: A whole town living inside the giant mall: storefronts are homes and shops, the food court is the market, the department store is the council hall, and a wall of stacked cars rings the parking lot.

locations.name: Union Rail Yard
locations.pitch: Freight cars in rows; one locomotive still has fuel.

locations.name: Sterling Municipal Airfield
locations.pitch: Crashed bombers on a cracked runway, guarded by robots that never got the stand-down order.

locations.name: Goldenrod
locations.pitch: The breadbasket: a farming town with a grain elevator, a mill and a weekly market.

locations.name: Splinter Creek
locations.pitch: A lumber town on the creek; the sawmill still runs on the water wheel.

locations.name: Copperhead
locations.pitch: A mining town in the southern hills; saloon, assay office, company scrip.

locations.name: Wellspring
locations.pitch: A plain crossroads town where the southern roads meet: a deep well, a general store, a saloon and the safest bed in the south.

locations.name: Clearwater
locations.pitch: Built around Lake Winona's old marina. Rows of solar stills, filter towers and cisterns turn lake water into the cleanest water in the Wastes; water caravans leave every morning and Clearwater's tokens are the closest thing to money.

locations.name: Sunbeam Commune
locations.pitch: A commune on the hill that worships the bomb's light; friendly, a little too friendly.

locations.name: Hangman's Gap
locations.pitch: Where the interstate leaves the valley, and the raiders who charge for it.

locations.name: Fort Steadfast
locations.pitch: A pre-war army base held by the grandchildren of its garrison; strict, well armed, recruiting.

locations.name: Our Lady of the Sands Mission
locations.pitch: Nuns run a clinic in an old adobe mission; they heal anyone who disarms at the gate.

locations.name: Big Wheel Truck Stop
locations.pitch: Caravans park their brahmin wagons by the old diesel pumps; the best rumours in the valley.

locations.name: Gus's Salvage
locations.pitch: Gus buys and sells anything metal; his dogs keep the peace.

locations.name: Ferryman's Landing
locations.pitch: A trading post on stilts; ferries cross here since the bridges fell.

locations.name: Lookout Station 3
locations.pitch: Rangers who still patrol the dead woods and hand out maps.

locations.name: Double-Bar Ranch
locations.pitch: A cattle ranch on the open range, always hiring hands to guard the herd from brutes.

locations.name: Bluebird Motor Lodge
locations.pitch: A neon-signed motel on the interstate; drifters rent rooms, nobody asks questions.

locations.name: Buzzard Mesa - the Grinder
locations.pitch: The raiders' stronghold on top of a sheer mesa, decorated with what's left of their enemies; one switchback road up.

locations.name: Ridgeback Dam
locations.pitch: Engineers live inside the dam's galleries and keep two turbines spinning. They sell charged batteries and run power lines to anyone who pays, which makes them the richest people in the valley and the biggest target.

locations.name: The Hollow Sun
locations.pitch: The bomb's crater, still glowing; something valuable waits at the bottom for anyone who survives it.

locations.name: Bonewhite Flats
locations.pitch: Salt harvesters live in the hangars of an old rocket-car test track. They rake salt, cure meat for half the Wastes and race patched-up atomic cars on the flats every month.

locations.name: Civil Defense Bunker Echo
locations.pitch: A sealed bomb shelter next door to Patchwork; the door opens for the first time in 80 years.

locations.name: Bright Hope Power Station
locations.pitch: Cooling towers on the river; the reactor is cold, the ghouls inside are not.

locations.name: Moonbeam Drive-In
locations.pitch: Raiders show scratched reels on the giant screen on Saturday nights.

locations.name: Deep Seven Mine
locations.pitch: Deep shafts under the hills; the miners dug too far.

locations.name: Redwall
locations.pitch: A town carved into both walls of Scorch Canyon: cliff homes, rope bridges, cargo lifts and hanging gardens watered by a spring at the bottom. The only way in is the lift, so nobody has ever taken it.

locations.name: Devil's Throat Tunnel
locations.pitch: A rail tunnel through the hills; derailed trains and shellback nests in the dark.

locations.name: Founders Bridge
locations.pitch: The broken interstate bridge into the city; a plank walkway across the gap and a toll gang at each end.

locations.name: Iron Gate
locations.pitch: Guards' and inmates' grandchildren live together in the old penitentiary: cell blocks are apartments, the yard is a farm, the guard towers still watch. Strict laws, fair trials, and the best bounty board in the Wastes.

locations.name: Starwatch Observatory
locations.pitch: A domed observatory on the highest hill; two old astronomers still chart the satellites.

locations.name: Radio KZAP
locations.pitch: The valley's only radio station; Lucky Larry plays records and reads the news you bring him.

locations.name: Blackrock Refinery
locations.pitch: Oil tanks and a burning refinery on the river; whoever runs it controls the fuel.

locations.name: Launch Site Zulu
locations.pitch: One missile was never launched. The silo's robots are still waiting for orders.

locations.name: Wreck of the Silver Comet
locations.pitch: A crashed atomic airliner in a field; the cargo hold was never found.

locations.name: Camp Whispering Pines
locations.pitch: Cabins in the dead woods; the campers never went home.

locations.name: Granite Bowl Quarry
locations.pitch: A flooded quarry with rusting machinery; good stone, bad water.

locations.name: Owl's Perch Tower
locations.pitch: A fire tower above the dead trees; the hermit inside sees everything that moves.

locations.name: Hushwood
locations.pitch: A ghost town in a hollow; the church bell still rings at midnight.

locations.name: Prometheus Research Center
locations.pitch: A pre-war research campus in the eastern hills; the experiments got out.

locations.name: Rattlebone Camp
locations.pitch: A raider camp south of Patchwork that preys on the interstate.

locations.name: Greenmarsh
locations.pitch: Stilt houses and boardwalks over the river marshes. The Co-op floods paddies, farms fish ponds and cranberry bogs, and feeds more people than anywhere else in the Wastes. Watch for gulpers in the reeds.

locations.name: Rimtown
locations.pitch: Ghouls who don't mind the radiation live on the rim of the Hollow Sun and dig the fused glowing glass out of the crater; their glass lamps light homes across the Wastes.
